GOONBRIDGE_TOKENS.description: JSON map member name -> token (push flips it to token -> member); one random 24+ character token per member; secrets:mint generates them, or paste ones you already hold.

ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Cloudflare Access for SaaS app client secret: Zero Trust > Access > Applications > your SaaS app > OIDC settings; only when Access guards the bridge.

GOONBRIDGE_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: shared secret for the GitHub webhook; secrets:mint generates it; paste the same value into the repo webhook settings.

GOONBRIDGE_ROUTINES.description: JSON map person -> {trigger, token}: each person's Claude Code routine trigger URL and token, from claude.ai routine settings.

GITHUB_CONFIG_PAT.description: fine-grained GitHub token with read access to the cloud config repo; GitHub > Settings > Developer settings; only with cloud.configBundle.

GOONBRIDGE_MEMBERS.description: JSON map sign-in email -> member name, for Access sign-in; pnpm run setup writes it from the answers.

accountId.description: Cloudflare account ID (32 hex characters): Cloudflare dashboard, Workers overview, right sidebar. Not a secret, but kept out of git.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: a scoped deploy token, Workers Editor: secrets:mint mints it from the minter token, or create one in the Cloudflare dashboard (My Profile > API Tokens).

contractToken.description: which member's token the post-deploy check uses: a member NAME, not a token.

^GOONBRIDGE_ROUTINE_[A-Z0-9]+_(TRIGGER|T.description: named routine trigger URL or token (GOONBRIDGE_ROUTINE_<NAME>_TRIGGER / _TOKEN), from the routine's settings on claude.ai.
